summary: Retire the legacy attention-to-person-ask importer after verifying no eligible fleet inputs.

replay.detail: Historical attention claims continue to decode and replay with their original identities and ages.

schema.detail: Tables, schema version, claim registrations and serialized request structures are unchanged.

rules.detail: Checkpoint and admission rule versions are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The retired importer no longer converts eligible legacy attention requests into new person-work. Current work ask, done and cancel interfaces stay unchanged, POST /v1/attention already refuses new requests, and historical attention claims remain readable.

downtime.detail: No interruption window or coordinated restart is required.

manual.detail: Before landing, run the bounded legacy-owner selector on every fleet member and require zero candidates. Keep the importer if any member has a candidate. Leave all historical requests untouched.

recovery.detail: Revert the cleanup if needed; retained claims and projections require no data repair.
